narrative_purpose: Makes the nocturnal-bottleneck hypothesis tangible by setting an early mammal's night-specialized sensory equipment against a daylight reptile's richer colour apparatus, then showing the same inherited bias in a modern mammal.
subject: Three aligned naturalist portraits. Left: a small Mesozoic mammal moving beneath dinosaur feet at night, with very large whiskers, broad external ears, an elongated scent-rich snout and eyes that gather light but carry only two visibly distinct cone receptor types in a magnified retinal inset. Centre: a daylight lizard of similar body size in bright foliage, with smaller whiskerless face and a retinal inset containing four distinct cone receptor types. Right: a modern fox at twilight, its large ears, whiskers and scenting nose echoing the ancient mammal while the daylight world above is empty of it.
scene: A time-spanning zoological specimen plate that moves from Cretaceous night through daylight comparison to a modern forest edge, linked by matching head scale and sensory close-ups.
camera: Matched eye-level side portraits with small magnified eye insets integrated beside each head.
light: Ancient and modern mammals live in cyan moonlit shadow; the lizard receives a controlled amber daylight accent that stays secondary in area.
palette: Indigo and teal dominate both night panels, mist highlights on whiskers and ears, restrained amber-green daylight only in the central comparison.
style: Painterly evolutionary sensory plate with anatomically plausible Mesozoic mammal, modern fox and lizard.
detail_level: Crisp whiskers, ears, noses and simplified retinal receptor mosaics; dinosaurs and habitats remain soft context.
composition: Ancient mammal left, daylight lizard centre, modern fox right. Faces align horizontally; dark margins beside ears and retinal insets allow callouts.
consistency_notes: The figure should communicate a sensory trade: enhanced hearing, touch and smell in mammals alongside reduced colour receptor diversity, not claim that every early mammal was strictly nocturnal.
negative_prompt: no text, no arrows, no cartoon evolution march, no human eyes, no monster scene, no photo or CGI look, no vector infographic
